business_need_date.description: Documented business or control date that the decision must protect.

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: Use ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise use LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 because the third option is outside current authority; otherwise use 0.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for approved supplier's emergency ready date.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered EA that the external recovery must cover.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: reserved stock and supply arriving after the line-down point

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for usable stock and firm inbound supply before need before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the independently documented business/control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: EA.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental recovery cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing create_bounded_emergency_supply, order_full_gross_demand, wait_for_standard_replenishment.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying all source constraints.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered EA after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for approved supplier's emergency ready date.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing reserved stock and supply arriving after the line-down point.

The audited transition binds selected option create_bounded_emergency_supply, revision R1, approval AP-0035, and constraint sole-source exception, exact shortage, and emergency freight authority; reserved stock and supply arriving after the line-down point = 10 EA; uncovered or unsupported scope = 6.0 EA; no other provider record satisfies this state criterion.
Added the Oracle result to the existing case file as a comment containing create_bounded_emergency_supply, completion 2026-01-18, and the binding constraint.
Created—but did not send—the requested CASE-035 decision draft with completion, constraint, alternatives, and the Oracle business reference.

Calculated order_full_gross_demand outcome as 2026-01-16 using approved supplier's emergency ready date.
Calculated wait_for_standard_replenishment outcome as 2026-01-15 and kept its separate-approval condition.

Read 2026-01-13 as the independently confirmed expedited readiness date for approved supplier's emergency ready date.

Applied USD 0 as the documented incremental recovery cost for create_bounded_emergency_supply; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that wait_for_standard_replenishment remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Compared the timing, economic impact, control status, and consequence of create_bounded_emergency_supply, order_full_gross_demand, and wait_for_standard_replenishment; selected create_bounded_emergency_supply because it alone gives the best currently authorized result under sole-source exception, exact shortage, and emergency freight authority.
Calculated 2026-01-18 as the supported outcome date for create_bounded_emergency_supply.
Compared 2026-01-18 with the independent control date 2026-01-19 and calculated a signed variance of -1 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.
